immutableSemantics: retained_immutable references retain original fetchedAt/body; current verifiedAt is a separate recheck clock.
notModifiedSemantics: 304 references retain their earlier full-body objects through reusesObservationId; they are not new full 200 responses.
requestCountAuthority: The daily fetch ledger is authoritative. Observation IDs include retained immutable verification and transport reuse; their count is not the number of requests.
